_comment: The Pressbooks Catalogs this application offers. Pressbooks calls them networks, which is why that word appears in the picker; the domain term is Catalog and no type is named after a network.

There is no directory API that enumerates Catalogs, so this list ships with the application. `bookCount` is what was observed at the probe and is recorded only to convey scale -- the live count comes from the X-WP-Total header at runtime, and these move.

`excluded` exists so that a Catalog nobody can reach is not re-added later by someone who rediscovers the problem by hand. Do not move an entry out of it without re-probing and recording what changed.

Every entry below was probed on 2026-08-17 with the User-Agent the importer sends, `Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; LibreTexts Reader/0.1.0)`. That matters: these hosts answer an unrecognised client with 403, so a probe with a bare tool name reports far more of them unreachable than really are.

networks.name: Remixing Open Textbooks through an Equity Lens (ROTEL)

excluded.reason: Bot protection. Answers the importer with HTTP 403 and an HTML block page rather than the API. This is the Pressbooks Directory host; its api.pressbooks.com backend is an undocumented JS application, not a public API.
